nights.title: WIDOWSPEAK
nights.name: Widowspeak
nights.extract: Widowspeak is an American indie rock band from Brooklyn, New York City, United States. The band consists of guitarist and vocalist Molly Hamilton and guitarist Robert Earl Thomas.

nights.title: beabadoobee: The Powerlines Tour
nights.name: Beabadoobee
nights.extract: Beatrice Kristi Ilejay Laus, known professionally as Beabadoobee, is a Filipino and British singer and songwriter. From 2018 to 2021, she released five extended plays (EPs) under the independent label Dirty Hit: Lice (2018), Patched Up (2018), Loveworm (2019), Space Cadet (2019) and Our Extended Play (2021). Her debut studio album Fake It Flowers was released in October 2020, and received critical acclaim. Her second studio album, Beatopia, was released on July 2022, and spawned the hit "The Perfect Pair". Her third studio album, This Is How Tomorrow Moves, was released in August 2024; it became her first album to peak atop the UK Albums Chart. In September 2026, her fourth studio album, Pylon topped the British and Australian charts.

nights.title: Eagles of Death Metal
nights.name: Eagles of Death Metal
nights.extract: Eagles of Death Metal is an American rock band from Palm Desert, California, formed in 1998. Founded by Jesse Hughes and Josh Homme (drums), the band includes a wide range of other musicians who perform both on the band's studio albums and at live shows.

nights.title: The Temperance Movement - Let It All Out Tour 2026
nights.name: The Temperance Movement
nights.extract: The Temperance Movement are a British blues rock supergroup formed in 2011 by Glasgow-born vocalist Phil Campbell and guitarists Luke Potashnick and Paul Sayer. The rhythm section consists of bassist Nick Fyffe and drummer Simon Lea. The band released their Pride EP in 2012, and their eponymous debut studio album was released on 16 September 2013. Collectively the band have a rich history of experience, having previously played with Rooster, Ben's Brother, Jamiroquai, Ray Davies, The Waterboys and Feeder.

nights.title: Déyyess
nights.name: Déyyess
nights.extract: Hannah Jennifer Marie Butcher, known professionally as Déyyess, is an English singer-songwriter. She has released a number of singles and two EPs.
